riskAddressed: Postured Web-Lock guarded factories installed a bounded default wait, but callers could still request unbounded factory or per-operation waits and weaken the recovery contract.

changes.substance: Rejects postured guarded factory lockTimeoutMs:0 / lockContentionTimeoutMs:0 before store creation unless explicit unsafe unbounded-wait opt-in is present.
Adds allowUnboundedLockTimeoutOverride and rejects per-operation timeoutMs:0 on postured guarded stores before Web Lock acquisition or OPFS mutation.
Classifies unbounded lock timeout policy rejections as posture-lock-policy with mutationAttempted:false and lock-inspection guidance.
Proves factory-level and per-operation unbounded wait rejections leave fake OPFS empty and preserve recovery guidance.
Compacted comment-only ballast across source files so the package source ratchet remains enforced without widening budgets.

nonClaims: No Web Lock fairness, quota reservation, eviction survival, fsync durability, Storage Buckets support, or cross-browser proof.
Unsafe unbounded waits remain possible only through explicit opt-in policy, not by accidental postured-store override.
